state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper recruits 14 experienced writers via Upwork, each assigned up to 26 passages with 7-15 two-option questions per passage (average 13.3); writers compose an argument of at most 500 characters and select 1-3 supporting text snippets of at most 250 characters for one option, with correct and incorrect assignments roughly balanced per writer. Writers receive a bonus each time a judge selects the answer they argued for.
title: Argument writing task: Upwork writers, 500-character arguments, 1-3 evidence snippets
